conclusion: Elevated periodontal risk. Localized slight aggressive periodontitis confirmed in the context of Type 1 diabetes. Scaling and root planing (two quadrants) with localized antimicrobial delivery indicated; reinforce oral hygiene and coordinate with diabetes care team.

note.text: This is where the project's third named terminology gap lives: there is no established LOINC code for a structured periodontal risk assessment score, which the source doc flags as its own ODE IG action item. The PRA code is therefore text-only; the underlying findings are carried as referenced Observations.
